note: Key names only, never values. Mirrors what the deploy adapters check: scripts/release/atomic-deploy-aphrody-stack.sh (Aphrody stack env files in /etc/aphrody) and scripts/release/atomic-deploy-shenron.sh (required keys of shenron-site/shenron-bot across their unit env files). provision-aphrody-stack-env.sh --fresh-host writes the Aphrody keys; `aphrody-infra secrets check --service ID --env-file FILE` checks one file.

secrets.name: APHRODY_SITE_WEB_BACKEND_TOKEN
secrets.description: Upstream bearer, equal to the Web API BXC_API_TOKEN (64 hex)

secrets.name: BXC_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Backend bearer shared with the site (APHRODY_SITE_WEB_BACKEND_TOKEN)

secrets.name: APHRODY_WEB_DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Same PostgreSQL aphrody_web DSN as the site

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional Gemini embedder for the BXC index (hashing embedder otherwise)

secrets.name: APHRODY_MCP_DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: PostgreSQL aphrody DSN (role aphrody_ai_http): AI RAG and Shenron corpus

secrets.name: APHRODY_SHENRON_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bearer of /api/v1/shenron/* (server-side name; clients read APHRODY_AI_HTTP_TOKEN)

secrets.name: APHRODY_AI_CHAT_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Not a secret: OpenAI-compatible chat origin, http://127.0.0.1:8798/v1 (aphrody-llama-gemma4.service)

secrets.name: APHRODY_AI_CHAT_MODEL
secrets.description: Not a secret: chat model alias served there, gemma4-e2b

secrets.name: DISCORD_TOKEN_SHENRON
secrets.description: Shenron bot token (legacy DISCORD_TOKEN accepted by the bot)

secrets.name: API_ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: Bearer of the bot admin API routes

secrets.name: APHRODY_AI_CHAT_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Not a secret: OpenAI-compatible chat origin, http://127.0.0.1:8798/v1 (aphrody-llama-gemma4.service)

secrets.name: APHRODY_AI_CHAT_MODEL
secrets.description: Not a secret: chat model alias served there, gemma4-e2b

secrets.name: SHENRON_MCP_LOG
secrets.description: tracing filter (e.g. info); the public read-only server needs no secret

secrets.name: SHENRON_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
secrets.description: Host headers accepted besides loopback and dragonballfr.com

secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret token for signing session JWT tokens

secrets.name: OVH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: OVH OAuth2 service account client id (aphrody ovh); service account of account eu8427-ovh

secrets.name: OVH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: OVH OAuth2 service account client secret

secrets.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Alert channel of aphrody notify (/etc/aphrody/notify.env); any one of Slack, Telegram or Matrix

secrets.name: DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Rose Griffon main Discord Bot token
